faq.question: Can I reserve?
faq.answer: Yes — reservations can be made by phone or email, and are recommended for evening visits.

faq.question: Do you offer custom orders?
faq.answer: Small custom requests for private groups and events are welcome with advance notice.

faq.question: Are there vegan or gluten-free options?
faq.answer: Several menu items can be adapted — please let your server know about any dietary needs.

faq.question: Where are you located?
faq.answer: 128 Orchard Lane, Riverside District, Springfield — see the map on our Contact page.

faq.question: What are your opening hours?
faq.answer: Open daily from morning through evening, with extended hours Thursday through Saturday.
